It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. The current Dos Anclas producer-owned site has a live product catalogue covering salts, spices, seasonings and related food products; it supports current producer identity and offer but does not itself state the Macachín plant address.

The national agricultural resolution identifies Compañía Introductora de Buenos Aires S.A.'s registered food establishment in Macachín, La Pampa, and names its table-salt products; it is an older plant authorization and does not independently prove current operation.

The August 2026 report identifies Dos Anclas's Macachín factory in La Pampa and states that it sustained production after the 2023 San Luis plant fire; it also places La Pampa in the company's current operating network.

The current producer-owned site identifies Elkargune as a honey producer near Victorica, La Pampa, on a 33-hectare beekeeping property; it publishes a direct WhatsApp number and exact coordinates and describes liquid and creamed honey.
